legal.terms.title: Terms of use
legal.terms.independence: Bandora is independent and is not affiliated with the organisations that run IELTS. IELTS is a trademark of the British Council, IDP and Cambridge Assessment English.
legal.terms.scores: Bands shown by Bandora are estimates and are not official. They are not an official IELTS score, and Bandora does not guarantee a score.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy
legal.privacy.collected: Sign-up collects your name and mobile number. Practice, placement and mock answers are stored. A speaking recording is stored if you submit one.
legal.privacy.storage: This data is kept on servers outside Iran, at Railway and Supabase. Answer text and audio are sent to AvalAI for scoring. AvalAI uses other companies' AI models for that scoring.
legal.privacy.audio: A speaking recording is kept for 90 days and then deleted.
legal.privacy.deletion: You delete the account from the profile page by typing the word حذف. Sessions end, the name and number are removed or anonymised, and that account's audio files are deleted. Invoices and payment records stay, without the name and number. The same number can be used to sign up again.
legal.refund.title: Refunds
legal.refund.window: Within 7 days of payment, the full amount of that purchase is returned if you have not used AI scoring or a premium mock. The same rule applies to the monthly and quarterly plans.
legal.refund.request: Send the request to the contact email. The amount is returned and the premium subscription ends.
legal.refund.used: If you used AI scoring or a premium mock during those 7 days, the amount is not returned.
